'''Mikul''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] who lived during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. Stationed on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], he ran a small shop, where he built and sold [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]] and other weaponry.
